page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6r.8xlarge is an arm64-based compute-optimized server instance powered by a 2.8 GHz Ampere Altra processor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores with a single thread per core, providing 32 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a 2.0 GB memory-per-core ratio. This instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying on external network-attached storage. Baseline network bandwidth is rated at 8 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates balanced multi-threaded performance but exhibits lower single-core efficiency. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores fall into the average and weak categories respectively, reflecting the lower single-threaded throughput typical of this architecture. However, multi-threaded operations scale effectively, as evidenced by a strong bzip3 multi-threaded decompression score of 217.66 GB/sec and average multi-core marks in Geekbench and stress-ng. Memory bandwidth is robust, reaching 2274.67 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 156.84 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

The hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for highly parallelized workloads that do not require high single-thread clock speeds or local storage. It is well-suited for containerized microservices, multi-threaded web serving, software compilation, and moderate database operations. The lack of local storage and GPU accelerators limits its applicability for heavy disk-bound databases or large-scale deep learning training, but it serves as an efficient platform for distributed arm64 development and general multi-threaded compute tasks.
